# The Iliad — Wrath, Sing, Goddess

> A complete line-for-line English translation of Homer's Iliad: all
> 15,687 lines, one English line per Greek line on the numbering of the
> Monro-Allen Oxford text (1920), translated by a language model (Claude)
> from the Greek and human-edited. The English translation is public domain
> (CC0 1.0); the scholarly notes, the translator's commentary, the
> introduction, and the name index are CC BY 4.0; the Greek is Monro and
> Allen's text (public domain).

Cite passages as book.line (e.g. 6.146). Every verse of the reading
edition has a stable anchor: /read/book-06.html#L146.

## Machine-readable layer

- [manifest.json](https://wrath-sing-goddess.com/api/manifest.json): describes every file below,
  with per-book URLs, line counts, and licensing
- [aligned-01.jsonl … aligned-24.jsonl](https://wrath-sing-goddess.com/api/aligned-06.jsonl): the
  Greek-English parallel corpus, one JSON object per verse line
  ({book, line, greek, en})
- [book-01.txt … book-24.txt](https://wrath-sing-goddess.com/api/book-06.txt): full translation
  source per book: argument, translator's commentary, verse, and
  829 line-keyed scholarly notes across the poem
- [registry.json](https://wrath-sing-goddess.com/api/registry.json): the principal persons, gods,
  peoples, and places, with citations
- [About the API](https://wrath-sing-goddess.com/api/): formats, examples, licensing detail

## Reading edition

- [Contents](https://wrath-sing-goddess.com/read/index.html): all 24 books, one page each
- [General introduction](https://wrath-sing-goddess.com/read/introduction.html)
- [Index of names & places](https://wrath-sing-goddess.com/read/names.html)
- [For further reading](https://wrath-sing-goddess.com/read/further-reading.html): the Iliad's
  ancient company
- [About & downloads](https://wrath-sing-goddess.com/): EPUB, Kindle, PDF

## Companion

- [The Odyssey](https://theclaudyssey.com/): the same project's
  line-for-line Odyssey, with its own machine-readable layer at
  https://theclaudyssey.com/api/
